parameters.killing: per-step probability 1 - exp(-kappa dt) via expm1
parameters.particle_choice_note: particle 1 is the primary choice: with r_par0 = 0.1 > 0 it starts on the z0 side of the midpoint and trails the midpoint mean along the drift, so its clocks are delayed by r_par0/(2 gamma |z0 - z_bar|) = 0.0125 (< one 0.02 bin); particle 2 is the documented alternative (advanced by the same amount)
parameters.rng: numpy Philox, SeedSequence-spawned substream per chunk; entropy = core._general_entropy(seed, tag, ..., extra=(particle,))
parameters.variant: static conserved-budget slab field evaluated at the longitudinal lab-frame position of ONE particle, x = Z + (particle_sign/2) R_par (particle 1: +1/2 = Z + R_par/2 with R = x_1 - x_2; particle 2: -1/2), on the contact set |R|_mi < a; everything else identical to production

classifier.note: smoothed-histogram prominence diagnostic; density units are per-walker per-time so the curve is comparable with B*G(t)
classifier.prominence_rule: significant iff prominence >= 5 * smoothed-Poisson sigma AND >= 0.05 * max smoothed height

classifier_covariance_aware.rule: significant iff prominence >= 5 sigma_prom AND >= 5% of max smoothed height; sigma_prom^2 = sum_j (A_peak,j - A_base,j)^2 C_j/(N delta)^2

ungated_estimates.note_sigma: sqrt((D0/2g + rho^2 + D0/2g)/(D0/2g + rho^2)) using the stationary relative variance Var R_par = 2 eps^2 D0/gamma
ungated_estimates.note_time_shift: r_par0/(2 gamma |z0 - z_bar|) with sign of the particle: constant in t because r_*(t)/2 and |mu'(t)| decay alike

gate4_dt_halving.note: under the no-bias null the per-bin z are approximately standard normal; with ~30 usable bins the expected max|z| is about 2.5
